docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — HuntingCube Manual Tester
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==MANUAL TESTER==  ·  FUNCTIONAL & REGRESSION TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Manual testing professional with **4.8 years of experience** conducting functional and regression testing of applications. Executed test cases, documented defects, and collaborated with developers across payment, gaming, retail, and education domains. Strong QA fundamentals and proven ability to work independently and in teams.
